stages.title: the progressive tap ladder on 「朝」: furigana → gloss → plain

assertions.name: before any tap the reading is hidden (ふりがな 触れて)
FINDING · overlapping 44px hit regions
assertions.detail: the geometric center of narrow token 0「朝」resolves to its DOM-later neighbour (BUTTON.tok plain particle); the tap landed at fx=0.35 instead. Adjacent expanded hit regions overlap and the later token wins — a center-tap on a one-kanji word can fall on the following (inert) particle.

assertions.name: tap 1 lifts the furigana
tap 2 opens the English gloss beneath
tap 3 closes the circle back to plain kanji
